comment: Structural registry of Underdog 6-man weekly NFL draft formats. Only formats with VERIFIED structure belong here - never guess rounds or roster bounds. roster_min/roster_max keys are QB/RB/WR/TE. payouts_file names a JSON in this directory with that contest's prize table.

formats.name: Battle Royale
formats.notes: Flagship weekly: QB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX, one pooled tournament; 2023-24 fields ran 28-68k entries.
